g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Ball rim sampled before seam; near-duplicate seam endpoints omitted at the rim. Camera lens and body are separate; hoop outer and inner contours retain the large opening. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Camera body, ball surface and hoop ring are lower grey; boundaries and ball seam higher black. Camera lens centre and hoop opening remain white unraised. No measured-height or material claim.
